description: The unchanged five-being, two-world PartFreePlurality joint interpretation has a weakly connected, well-founded actual causal graph at false, definitionally equal to its actual existential-support graph. Its distinct actual left/right sources both cause instrument; their upstream paths have no common extension. Upstream confluence and rooted-at-unique-source therefore fail, while the full earlier joint control remains true. This certifies satisfiability of the encoded commitments and a precise obstruction to applying the existing rooted theorem, not metaphysical possibility, real instantiation, explanatory adequacy or God’s uniqueness.
